status: retrospective planning estimate only; not a frozen or completed audit
cost_method: Planning, not measured throughput: whole selected HTML content at 250 visible words/minute + 1 minute check (minimum 2); partial HTML +3 gap review. Issue accounting 5 minutes, plus 3 per named complete marked page; TOC/index listing accounting 2. Coarsened issue+TOC charged once. Stratum cost rounds up mean unit cost; seed-dependent actual selections may cost more. Additional image pages or recovered material add work.

full_content_views.label: Original full-content-view interpretation
full_content_views.protocol_section: PROTOCOL §5, Review budget and random audit
protocol_sentences: An issue audit checks contents/page/attachment accounting; it does not read the issue cover to cover.
Pages, filings and history slices selected for content are read in full.
full_content_views.interpretation: Issue PDFs/TOCs receive accounting; a selected HTML issue section is treated as a full content view. The section-as-content choice is an interpretation, not an explicit protocol sentence.

container_accounting.label: Alternative container-accounting interpretation (user requested)
container_accounting.protocol_section: PROTOCOL §5, Review budget and random audit
protocol_sentences: An issue audit checks contents/page/attachment accounting; it does not read the issue cover to cover.
Pages, filings and history slices selected for content are read in full.
container_accounting.interpretation: Extend issue-style accounting to HTML issue sections. Check every listed item against the accepted/rejected union, then read ONE complete source item per sampled container. The nested one-item draw is this requested alternative, not an already frozen protocol amendment.
container_accounting.cost_method: Per container: 5 + 0.5 × listed items, plus max(2, ceil(median full-item words / 250) + 1). No additional whole-section read or old marked-page surcharge is added; existing scan/partial strata and floors remain. Non-containers retain the original rule. Stratum means round up; actual one-item draws can exceed the median allowance.
inventory_limitations: Counts are displayed source items, not accepted entity counts or sums of completion fields.
PDF/TOC share expanded issue-wide items, not just top-level TOC headings. Display-repeated HTML actions remain separate accounting rows; PDF counts native action closings once.
PDF-only native-action lengths use native closing-marker segments; no-number HTML counterparts may not match native PDF heading order. These are flagged sizing candidates, not adjudicated identities.

Annual guidance catalogue rows contribute separate accounting items. They are excluded from the one-complete-notice/action read pool: a pointer row is not the full linked guidance text. Complete guidance publication notices remain eligible. This nested population definition must be reviewed before any future seed.
No item was drawn and no seed generated. A future item frame must resolve flagged residuals and full-item/linked-document boundaries before sampling.

container_accounting_participation_read.label: Alternative container-accounting + participation read (user requested; owner approval required)
container_accounting_participation_read.protocol_section: PROTOCOL §5, Review budget and random audit
protocol_sentences: An issue audit checks contents/page/attachment accounting; it does not read the issue cover to cover.
Pages, filings and history slices selected for content are read in full.
container_accounting_participation_read.interpretation: Extend issue-style accounting to HTML issue sections, as in container-accounting. ONE future seeded complete notice/action supplies the participation passages and remaining-body native search. This weakens "Pages, filings and history slices selected for content are read in full." It is not protocol compliance under that sentence without owner approval.
container_accounting_participation_read.cost_method: Same accounting (5 + 0.5 × listed items), same complete-item pool and non-container costs. Item (b): max(2, ceil(preamble/participation words / 250) + 1) + 1 minute per residual native-text search occurrence + 2 overhead. Per-container allowance is median of eligible individual item (b) costs. Same predeclared coarsening order, strata, floors, rounded-up stratum means and 271 mandatory minutes. Context reading is charged through hit minutes, not counted a second time as passage words.

passage_and_search_method.word_cost: max(2, ceil(preamble/participation words / 250) + 1); retain original one-minute check and two-minute minimum
passage_and_search_method.b_cost: word cost + residual search hits + 2 minutes overhead; median of individual eligible-item costs per container, not separately combined medians
passage_and_search_method.passages: All pre-body heading/preamble/summary paragraphs and later textbl/textbi/summary preamble-style paragraphs; text outside paragraph nodes is charged as heading/preamble. Whole Parts/Articles/VAC sections whose headings match participation keywords; each other paragraph matching comment*, hearing*, petition*, effective, date(s), objection*. Other notices/no reliable body boundary conservatively read whole.
passage_and_search_method.search: Remaining native text only: nonoverlapping comment*, hearing*, objection*, ISO dates, numeric month/day/year or month-day-year, month-name/day dates and standalone 19xx/20xx years. Year-like legislative/code citations deliberately count as possible dates. Bare slash fractions (1/3, 1/6) are excluded. Each occurrence costs one minute, even repeated; context is its paragraph and adjacent paragraphs, deduplicated only for context word reporting.
passage_and_search_method.pdf: HTML counterpart closest to median full-body size supplies structured passage counts where available; PDF-only native blocks use lines/blank lines and VAC boundaries. Counts are sizing estimates, not completed human reads.

b_cost_summary.instance_weighting: Unselected displayed item instances across all 229 containers; overlapping HTML/PDF/TOC representations repeat here. Not a seeded distribution. Planning uses each container median, not this pooled median.

scripted_accounting_sampled_verification.label: scripted accounting + sampled verification (PROTOCOL amendment and owner approval required)
scripted_accounting_sampled_verification.protocol_section: PROTOCOL §5, Review budget and random audit
protocol_sentences: An issue audit checks contents/page/attachment accounting; it does not read the issue cover to cover.
Pages, filings and history slices selected for content are read in full.
The human checks boundaries, accepted labels, exclusions and overlooked candidates in originals.
scripted_accounting_sampled_verification.interpretation: A primary-produced scripted crosswalk supplies every listed item to a latest union notice/rejection record or unaccounted. Scripting is agent work, zero owner minutes. Owner checks every unaccounted row plus min(accounted rows,5) future seeded accounted-row verifications and performs the same one-item participation read as costing P. This replaces full human item accounting and weakens content read-in-full; it requires a PROTOCOL amendment and owner approval. No amendment is applied here.
scripted_accounting_sampled_verification.cost_method: Per sampled container: (a) 3 base + unaccounted rows + min(accounted rows,5), at 1 minute per checked row; (b) same per-container median participation-read item cost as P. All non-containers, coarsening order, strata, sample sizes, floors, stratum-mean ceilings and 271 mandatory minutes unchanged. No overhead for agent scripting is charged to owner.
scripted_accounting_sampled_verification.unaccounted_method: Conservative scripted source/union-label matching, not a zero-unaccounted assumption; ambiguous/unmatched rows cost one minute each. Explicit whole-agency catalogue rejection spans can cover many source rows; boundary-crossing rows remain unaccounted. Accounted means pointer coverage, not label correctness. See crosswalk method and row-level reasons.
